name: harness
description: Harness — a lightweight reasoning floor. Author a declarative goal-spec, then a fixed engine runs decompose→act→independent-check→loop: each subgoal is executed by one subagent and judged by a SEPARATE subagent (no self-eval), with bounded retry. Purpose is to filter out repetition and below-threshold answers, holding the flow even at low effort / weaker models. B (goal-spec + engine) is the default; A (bespoke Workflow) covers custom control flow. Enforcement (hook/skill) deferred.
